stem: 在以下哪种情况下，金融机构可以披露可疑活动报告（SAR）？

options.A: 法院命令要求银行披露该 SAR，但须先获得法律团队的同意。
options.B: 客户询问有关向当地金融情报机构（FIU）报告的可能性。
options.C: 外部顾问询问 SAR 的详情。
options.D: 第三国警方直接查询有关该客户的信息。

stem_en: In which of the following cases can a financial institution disclose a suspicious activity report (SAR)?

options_en.A: A court order requests the bank to disclose the SAR, subject to obtaining agreement from the legal team
options_en.B: A customer asks about potential reporting to the local Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
options_en.C: An external consultant inquires about the details of the SAR
options_en.D: A third-country police force directly inquires about the customer
